reasons: Missing-clause finding is correct: the cited General Provisions run to 10.8 (Headings; Counterparts) with no insurance obligation, and the vendor is a hosting/services provider that processes our Confidential Information and user/order data, so the walk-away condition is engaged and an insert is the right remedy.

The inserted Section 10.9 tracks the playbook preferred position exactly (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, term plus one year) and is a pure addition that leaves p0070 untouched — the smallest edit that reaches the position.
Placement at the end of Section 10 follows the redline guidance and picks up the Section 10 survival language; deterministic checks confirm the insurance obligation is present.
Comment is accurate, concise, in our voice, explains the gap and the added coverages, and correctly offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).

Minor drafting nit only (not disqualifying): clause (c)'s trailing phrase "...USD 5,000,000, HDI processing Confidential Information, user information and data hereunder" is a dangling construction; recommend "given HDI's processing of Confidential Information, user information and data hereunder" or simply deleting the phrase, since the coverage obligation is otherwise unconditional and clear.
